findings.title: Fallback results are cached without the site-default locale
findings.body: Translations now depend on SiteSetting.default_locale, but the accelerator caches no-option I18n.t calls using only the key, current locale, and backend object ID. A missing French key resolved through German will therefore remain German after the site default changes to Spanish. The same cache collision can occur between sites sharing a multisite process. Include the fallback context in the cache key or invalidate cached translations when it changes.

findings.title: Load fallback locales outside controller requests too
findings.body: Fallback locales are loaded only by this controller callback. The accelerator disables automatic translation loading, and I18n.translate still loads only the current locale. A background worker translating in French on a site whose default is German will skip existing German fallback strings unless that locale happened to be loaded previously, returning English or a missing-translation message instead. Load the fallback chain through the shared translation entry point so non-controller callers receive the same fallback behavior.
